name: print-social-coral-to-teal-gradient-lock-screen-widget-post
title: Coral-to-Teal Lock Screen Widget Post
whatItIs: A square post styled as a phone lock screen on a coral-to-teal gradient with a huge white 9:00 clock, a date, three frosted widgets (Up next Devotional, Zion Online live services with social icons, and a weather-style Tempo card with a flame and 500°) and small captions at the top corners.
whatItMeans: Imitating a lock screen makes an announcement feel native to the phone, and the warm gradient feels welcoming.
techniques: Lock-screen layout used as a post

vocabulary.definition: A layout imitating a phone's locked display.
A translucent card imitating an operating-system widget.
Designing a post to look like a familiar interface.
